Loss report: gitlab -> forgejo
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (include) is not written to the GHA file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (extends) is not written to the GHA file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/script step.script (the line !reference [.remote-setup, script] depends on a remote GitLab include and has no GHA form)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/deploy ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (rules) is not written to the GHA file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/deploy job.if (condition not expressible in GitHub Actions; job disabled)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci pipeline.concurrency: concurrency group per run (Forgejo cancels earlier push and pull_request runs while concurrency is unset; the source had no concurrency, so each run gets its own group)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the pipeline named no runner)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build step.action: actions/checkout step (GitLab clones the repository before every job and GHA does not; GIT_DEPTH and GIT_SUBMODULE_STRATEGY map to the step inputs)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/deploy job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the pipeline named no runner)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/deploy step.action: actions/checkout step (GitLab clones the repository before every job and GHA does not; GIT_DEPTH and GIT_SUBMODULE_STRATEGY map to the step inputs)
[native] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/synth/checkout step.action (printed as an absolute URL; an instance that cannot reach https://github.com needs the URL edited)
[native] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/deploy/synth/checkout step.action (printed as an absolute URL; an instance that cannot reach https://github.com needs the URL edited)
